Chapter 7165: Time To Go

Chapter 7165: Time To Go

Perhaps only the high heaven had an answer to what lies beyond the void, the inscrutable beginning. However, none had the privilege to meet and talk with this being.

“Arises from the void.” A tranquil and selfless man opened his eyes and observed Li Qiye’s move.

After a long while, he sighed and said: “I’ve lost again.”

With that, he gazed upward and said: “I shall make the first move in the next round then. Even if I lose, I shall lose with dignity.”

***

A celestial immortal hidden in an unknown spot began to panic, murmuring: “So is he a true immortal?”

Another crossing into the future looked back and said: “Even the state of true immortality is not the ultimate end. We can’t win. No, we need a complete form, we have to borrow strength from Future, it is the only way.”

***

“Boom!” The high heaven shook violently and a pair of eyes could be seen. It didn’t speak but something pierced through time, on the verge of activating.

This was unprecedented since its power swept through Heavenrealm to everyone’s dismay. Even those with firm dao heart began to waver. After all, all lives were beneath the high heaven.

“Crackle!” Lightning ponds formed above them, accumulating until the inevitable destruction.

“The calamity is coming once the dam is released.” An immortal said.

***

Meanwhile, Li Qiye didn’t look at the high heaven. He raised his hand before releasing the technique at Skykiller.

This was an unknown world far larger than Heavenrealm. Even a true immortal was only one dot connecting numerous worlds.

“Bam!” The true immortal fell and shattered Skykiller’s defenses, smashing the divine beast into its palace. Despite having a near-indestructible physique, blood still stained the floor.

Skykiller resembled a broken porcelain vase, barely managing to stay intact.

Those in Divine Firmament were speechless. Some had tears streaming down their cheeks despite having been betrayed. They wanted to hate Phoenix Queen who had turned into their beloved king. She wanted to destroy their world and refine all of them regardless of their contributions and service. From start to finish, she viewed them as insects. Nonetheless, they still mourned her defeat.

As for the divine beasts, they prostrated while staring at Skykiller. The younger ones couldn’t help but sob and whimper. Their fate hinged upon Li Qiye’s whim.

Li Qiye landed before the palace and said: “You and other living beings, no different from insects.”

No divine beasts dared to answer, still looking down at the ground while kneeling.

“Sir, will you keep your words?” The broken Skykiller asked.

“I always do.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Good, good.” Skykiller laughed and said: “As you can see, I can’t get up to bow. Next time, then.”

“Very well.” Li Qiye said.

“It is time for me to go then, I have lost.” Skykiller stared at the divine beasts and spoke with disappointment and loneliness.

“Sorry...” Skykiller murmured to someone before apologizing to her race: “Sorry.”

“Sir, I will return this body to the living beings.” Skykiller said.

“Boom!” The body, dao power, true fate, and everything else exploded into the air, morphing into endless world energy.
